description: Daily prices for one symbol back-adjusted for corporate actions, with the cumulative adjustment factor and adj_close. Required: exchange, symbol. Without from and to it returns the last 90 days. Up to 250 rows per call, oldest first. End of day data only, no intraday or live prices. Coverage: NSE from 2010-01-04, BSE from 2024-07-08. Tier: needs a free API key (https://tejhq.dev/keys).

exchange.description: Exchange: nse or bse, lower case.

from.description: First date, inclusive. Default: 90 days before to. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

symbol.description: Exchange ticker, for example RELIANCE, TCS, M&M. Case does not matter.

to.description: Last date, inclusive. Default: today. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

name: adjusted
title: Back-adjusted daily prices
